description: High-conversion psychological turnaround sequence triggered when seller goes silent post-offer.

campaigns.name: Post-Offer Thank You & Recap
campaigns.copy: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, thanks for taking the time to review our numbers on {{property.address}}! I sent the full breakdown to your email. Let me know if you have any questions!

campaigns.name: Numbers Clarification
campaigns.copy: {{contact.first_name}}, just wanted to make sure the net calculation was clear — remember, we cover 100% of closing costs with zero fees deducted from your payout.

campaigns.name: Post-Offer Discovery Call
campaigns.instructions: Rep follow-up dial to resolve price or terms friction.

campaigns.name: Day 1 Post-Offer Check
campaigns.copy: Morning {{contact.first_name}}! Did you have a chance to review the offer with your family?

campaigns.name: Terms Flexibility Option
campaigns.copy: {{contact.first_name}}, if the closing date or terms need adjusting, we have plenty of room to customize the agreement for you. What would work best on your timeline?

campaigns.name: Manager Escalation Call
campaigns.instructions: Sales Manager second-voice call to unblock seller hesitation.

campaigns.name: Chris Voss Takeaway SMS
campaigns.copy: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, have you given up on selling {{property.address}}?

campaigns.name: Earnest Deposit Re-allocation Notice
campaigns.copy: {{contact.first_name}}, we can hold our earnest funds allocation for another 24 hours. Should I keep this reserved or release it to another property?

campaigns.name: Final Opportunity Nudge
campaigns.copy: Let me know if we should talk today before the current offer expires, {{contact.first_name}}!

campaigns.name: Gentle Release & File Archival
campaigns.copy: Totally understand if the timing isn't right, {{contact.first_name}}. I'll close out this specific offer for now. Reach out anytime if things change!
